verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents a SQL API, a REST API you can use to perform queries and access data. It also has OpenAPI-compliant REST APIs for programmatic resource control and a Snowflake-managed MCP server that can serve SQL executions to AI agents, all governed by role-based access control. So an agent can run governed SQL without a dashboard. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the authentication flow (keys/OAuth) for agents, explicit schema-discovery endpoints or commands, evidence that the Snowflake CLI itself executes SQL and returns results (its evidence covers app management only), detail on the result format, and independent hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent workflow.
